description: Values on a TransactionRecord's key path that are not what their step reads, on which the Python and TypeScript verifiers must refuse alike. Each case is transaction-record-parties.json's one-round control with one value changed and record_hash resealed (the record_hash cases excepted). A verification method or signature is read by type, never by truthiness: a value that is not a non-empty string names no key, or is no JWS, so that act's signature does not verify; a JWS whose protected header is not a JSON object does not verify either. Verify each record with did_documents (the two parties' documents, as in transaction-record-parties.json) and the case's offer_hashes; both implementations must reach expected_reason (null when it verifies).
